response.reasoning: Brief specifies a 4BHK luxury villa with premium amenities (infinity pool, helipad, home theatre) that fall outside the supported catalogue scope. The brief explicitly requests >3BHK (4 bedrooms) and architectural features (swimming pool, helipad) not present in any of the nine candidate Tier-2 templates.
response.refusal_reason: 4BHK exceeds the supported 1/2/3 BHK range. Additionally, infinity pool and helipad are not features supported by any candidate template. The catalogue covers compact residential (1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK houses, duplexes, and towers); luxury villas with pools and helipads require a bespoke design or a specialized villa template not available in this Tier-2 set.
